// Field-channel corpus for the taint engine (TestTaintIsKeyedByField). Field
// taint is keyed by the field: output stored in Result.Log by one function and
// read into an error by another trips; a store to Pair.Other never taints a
// read of Pair.Log.
package field

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os/exec"
)

type Result struct {
	Log   string
	Other string
}

func record(c *exec.Cmd, res *Result) {
	out, _ := c.Output()
	res.Log = string(out)
}

func report(res *Result) error {
	return fmt.Errorf("run failed: %s", res.Log) // WANT taint
}

func reportOther(res *Result) error {
	return errors.New(res.Other)
}

type Pair struct {
	Log   string
	Other string
}

func pair(c *exec.Cmd) error {
	var p Pair
	out, _ := c.Output()
	p.Other = string(out)
	return errors.New(p.Log)
}
